english.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese term for purifying a liquid by distilling, including repeated or continuous distillation.

examples.english: This liquor needs several rounds of distillation before it is pure enough.
examples.traditional: 呢種酒要經過幾次蒸餾，先至夠純。
